{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000003B5GXSEW43YP9","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=right
group kms "kms-service" {
  node Iface "Provider"
  node GitHubP "github.ts"
  node LinearP "linear.ts"
  node Ingress "webhook ingress"
  node Grants "token + grant"
}
group compute "compute-service" {
  node Router "EventRouter"
  node Dispatch "TriggersDispatcher"
}
group github "plugin-github" {
  node Sync "sync operation"
}
node Trigger "event trigger"
node App "GitHub App"
edge GitHubP implements Iface
edge LinearP implements Iface
edge Ingress depends-on Iface "verify, route"
edge Grants depends-on Iface "checkAccess"
edge App -> Ingress "signed webhook"
edge Ingress -> Router "github.com/o/r"
edge Router -> Dispatch "poke"
edge Dispatch -> Sync "run"
edge Trigger -> Grants "request grant" stroke=dashed
edge Trigger -> Router "register + UCAN" stroke=dashed
